reviews.text: Responsive, thorough, kind and efficient.  Great work! I only had the exterior window cleaning quoted but realized my error and had them come back the following week to clean the impossible-to-reach interior windows. Highly recommend Puresight! I will definitely be using them in the future.

I am so impressed by the clarity of my windows and sliding glass doors! My home looks very bright now. Excellent service, attention to detail, very professional and friendly too. Highly recommend Puresight Window Cleaning. ☆☆☆☆☆+ Thank you!!

Puresight just left my house. I used them for the first time, and I plan to use them every year. They were excellent!  Very thorough- very careful and did not rush.  Easy to work with in scheduling and fairly priced.

Iker did a wonderful job of cleaning my windows and gutters. They were so polite and kind and worked with a smile! It’s nice to see young people work hard and with a good attitude. He did a few extra things with no charge.
Iker is a great guy, super conscientious, and my windows are sparkling clean! Great service!

Iker always does an amazing job with my windows. He’s detailed and careful, but also gets the job done quickly. He’s very friendly, easy to schedule with via texts and also very fair pricing. Can’t recommend him highly enough.
Iker is the best!!!  He's on time, thorough, and inexpensive. Give him a try. He has done my windows several times and I have never had any problems. Willie and Jungle from Eagle

If you are looking for someone to clean your windows, so that you can appreciate the beautiful surroundings we live in, give them a call. Puresight was punctual, pleasant, reasonable and did an excellent job!
I've never had such a Professional Job  done. I would give Iker a 10+. You will be excited over his work and professionalism!
Excellent service for an excellent price
They did an amazing job. Super quick and efficient. Definitely will use them again in the future.

I couldn't be more pleased with the Puresight window cleaning by Iker Vigil, owner.  We have a large home in EagleVail and Iker did the whole job inside and out in 4 hours. Our windows look spectacular.  He was careful, meticulous, and courteous. The Puresight technique works extremely well with awesome results. I highly recommend this company and Iker Vigil.  Jan and Don.
Puresight is the best window cleaning service in the valley. Great customer service and excellent execution. My windows have never been cleaner.
Puresight  Window Cleaning is so professional. They do a great job and are extremely respectful of your home. They are very easy to work with and I would recommend them to everyone.
So well done, professional and kind! My windows are now spotless! I used Puresight Window Cleaning last year as well and will continue using them!
Great professor job. Windows are sparkling!  Highly recommend and will use again.
Professional and windows look great!
We highly recommend Iker!  The windows look great.  (no more bird poop, lol) He is very organized and professional.  5 stars for sure!
Iker did a wonderful job. It’s nice to see a young man work so hard to achieve his goals. I would recommend to all that you use his window washing services!
They did a fantastic job!
Iker was wonderful; he cleaned our windows inside and out. He was professional, thorough, polite, and did an excellent job. I would highly recommend puresight window cleaning.

Hard to find Window cleaning service in the Valley.
Well, I just found Puresight Window Cleaning. The gave me a free estimate, and were able to schedule the work pretty soon.
My windows look like new! So clean!! They did an awesome Job!
They are very proffesional, punctual, and courteous.
I highly recomend them!!!
